title: Sony BRAVIA KD-55XF7596 (2018, X75F series, model string "BRAVIA 4K GB ATV3", MediaTek mt5891), EU firmware
notes:
Sony BRAVIA KD-55XF7596 (2018, X75F series, model string "BRAVIA 4K GB ATV3", MediaTek mt5891), EU firmware
Product BRAVIA_ATV3_4K_EU, device BRAVIA_ATV3_4K (ro.build.product still says BRAVIA_ATV2). Android TV 9 (API 28).
Firmware Sony/BRAVIA_ATV3_4K_EU/BRAVIA_ATV3_4K:9/PTT1.190515.001.S54/672201:user/release-keys,
security patch 2022-01-05. 2 GB RAM (about 200 MB available with the stock UI), 8.1 GB /data, 3.4 GB free.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-kd-55xf7596/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-kd-55xf7596/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Same firmware build (S54 672201) and platform as examples/sony-xbr-65x900f, so this is that list plus
the leftovers examples/sony-kd-55xe8596 disables, with this owner's feature choices.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (restore.sh's default), HOME priority 2; the only other HOME
answer is com.android.tv.settings/com.sony.dtv.settings.system.FallbackHome. leanbacklauncher has no HOME.
Live TV / input app: com.sony.dtv.tvx. Keep it: it plays every HDMI input and the DVB tuner.
Keep: com.sony.dtv.tvinput.*, braviasync* (HDMI-CEC), remotepairing, rcpowerkey, uinputservice,
imeproxy, sonysystemservice, settingsprovider, all com.mediatek.* and mtktvapi.agent, timers,
webapi.core and remoteaccess (Sony IP control, Home Assistant), Play Store, Play Services, Gboard.
Also left alone, untested: com.sony.dtv.youview + com.youview.tv.servicehost (ship on the EU firmware
and hook into tvx), interactivetvutil, b2b.noderuntime.*, vewd/hbbtv, dialservice, servicemode.
Already off on this TV before the list: com.sony.dtv.promos, com.sony.dtv.smarthomesettings
(both listed below; restore leaves them disabled because the recovery record saw them that way).
Display: Physical size 1920x1080, Physical density 320, no overrides, display_density_forced null.

Applied 2026-10-21 in six batches (the sections below), checking Home, Netflix, HDMI 1 and the DVB-T input
after each one, then rebooted: all 38 still disabled, nothing re-enabled by the firmware, no crashes,
display values unchanged, MemAvailable up from about 200 MB to about 500 MB after boot.
Notes from this firmware:
- Android 9 has no topResumedActivity line: check apps and inputs with
`dumpsys activity activities | grep mResumedActivity`, and the input with
`dumpsys tv_input | sed -n '/sessionStateMap/,$p' | grep inputId` (HDMI 1 = ExternalTvInputService/HW2).
Netflix screencaps come back empty too, like HDMI and Live TV.
- disable.sh skips com.sony.dtv.smarthomesettings: it asks for TV_INPUT_HARDWARE. It was already off from
the factory/owner and `pm query-services -a android.media.tv.TvInputService` does not list it, so it is a
false positive here; no TVINPUT_ALLOW needed while it stays off.
- Launcher works: built from launcher/ and installed with build-and-install.sh, which disables tvlauncher
(HOME priority 2) before set-home-activity. Home confirmed with `dumpsys window | grep mFocusedApp`
(on Android 9 it is in dumpsys window, not dumpsys activity) before and after a reboot; Netflix,
YouTube, Input, Settings and Home on the real remote all work without the accessibility services.
config.xml: hidden_apps com.sony.dtv.tvx and com.sony.dtv.tvxlauncher.programguide,
live_tv_package com.sony.dtv.tvx. The UI stays at 1920x1080 / 320 dpi, no zoom.
- With katniss and backdrop off, voice_interaction_service and screensaver_components still name them;
Android ignores disabled components, and leaving them means restore.sh brings both back untouched.
